kural: tip=kemal: imageReferences=[Kemal 02a]; tip=stil: imageReferences=[05a stil referansı]. Her görsel: generate-image -> (bekle) create-design Instagram Story (Portrait) -> export jpg 1080x1920 -> gorseller/ada9/canva/<sahne>.jpg ve gorseller/ada9/<sahne>.jpg; eskisini gorseller/ada9-flow-yedek'e al.
